'''Blackberry Cobbler''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It can also be received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]].

'''Note:''' This recipe can be [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients without [[Bear's Knowledge]], or if using [[Wheat Flour]] and/or [[Sugar]] from the [[Mill]].

==Tailoring==
Blackberry Cobbler is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt058.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
